settings.heading: Cakes for your event.
settings.lede: Weddings, celebrations, corporate gatherings and wellness events. Tell us about yours and we reply personally with a quote.
settings.meta: Four short steps. Minimum 70 cakes. No payment now.
settings.step1_help: Minimum 70. One cake per guest is a good starting point, plus any take-home extras.
settings.step1_hint: Any number from 70 up. Not sure yet? A rough number is fine, we refine it together.
settings.step2_question: Which flavors, and how will you serve them?
settings.step2_help: Type a number per flavor, or tick the box and we suggest a mix. Availability is confirmed for your date.
settings.flavors: Hazelnut, Chocolate Fudge, Pistachio, White Chocolate Matcha
settings.mix_label: Suggest a balanced mix for me
settings.extras_label: Add a personal touch or dietary notes (optional)
settings.custom_placeholder: Logo on the box, a message on each cake, colors to match the event...
settings.custom_help: Customization is available at an additional cost. We confirm options and pricing with your quote.
settings.step4_question: Where should we send the quote?
settings.message_placeholder: The occasion, timing on the day, anything we should know.
settings.fine_print: Pricing, packaging, customization and delivery are confirmed in your personalized quote, before anything is booked.
settings.success_text: We will come back to you personally with a quote for your event.
